description: Defines classes and types for private link outputs, including base class, specific implementations for time-based and usage-based links, and response wrappers for create, get, update, and delete operations.

classes.name: BasePrivateLinkOutput
classes.description: Abstract class with common properties for private link outputs, including link ID, event type ID, expiration status, and booking URL.

classes.name: TimeBasedPrivateLinkOutput
classes.description: Class extending BasePrivateLinkOutput, adding an expiration date for time-based private links.

classes.name: UsageBasedPrivateLinkOutput
classes.description: Class extending BasePrivateLinkOutput, adding maximum usage count and current usage count for usage-based private links.

classes.name: CreatePrivateLinkOutput
classes.description: Response wrapper class for creating private links, including status and data (either time-based or usage-based).

classes.name: GetPrivateLinksOutput
classes.description: Response wrapper class for retrieving multiple private links, including status and array of mixed link types.

classes.name: UpdatePrivateLinkOutput
classes.description: Response wrapper class for updating private links, including status and updated data.

classes.name: DeletePrivateLinkOutput
classes.description: Response class for deleting a private link, including status and link information.
